user.title: Music Assistant Podcasts
user.description: Connect to your Music Assistant server to aggregate the latest podcast episodes.

data.token: Long-lived access token (Settings → Profile → Long-lived access tokens)
data.username: Username (alternative: we create the token for you)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Music Assistant Podcasts
reauth_confirm.description: The Music Assistant token is no longer valid. Enter a new long-lived token, or your username and password to create one automatically.

error.missing_auth: Provide a long-lived token or a username and password.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed: check the token or credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Music Assistant server.
error.unknown: Unexpected error connecting to Music Assistant.

data.force_refresh: Ask providers for fresh episode data on every refresh (slower)

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Refresh the list of latest podcast episodes from Music Assistant.

play_episode.name: Play episode
play_episode.description: Play a single podcast episode on a Music Assistant player.

episode_uri.name: Episode URI
episode_uri.description: URI of the podcast episode, e.g. library://podcast_episode/1/2.

entity_id.name: Player
entity_id.description: Target media player (defaults to the configured player).
